summary: Real-time mech warfare: conquer, customize, and dominate.
description:
Command your mech army to victory in MechCom - 3D RTS! Experience fast-paced, real-time strategy action optimized for mobile. In the resource-scarce year 2100, corporations BIOSPHERE and APEX clash over a newly discovered planet rich with exotic minerals. Take control and lead your chosen faction to dominate the battlefield.

Dive into classic RTS gameplay inspired by genre favorites like Warzone 2100 and Dune. Harvest resources, construct your base, and build a powerful force of customizable mechs. Deploy a diverse range of units and structures, from nimble scouts to heavily armed assault mechs, and adapt your strategy to counter your opponent.

Engage in thrilling battles across 12 diverse maps set in 3 unique landscapes. Outmaneuver the challenging AI in Ranked mode and climb through 7 ranks to prove your strategic prowess. Or, fine-tune your tactics in Custom Games against the AI.

MechCom - 3D RTS features:
* Deep RTS Gameplay: Experience core RTS mechanics, from resource management and base building to unit production and strategic combat.
* Customizable Mechs: Design your perfect war machine with 16 unique mech combinations and powerful upgrades.
* Challenging AI: Test your skills against a cunning AI opponent in Ranked and Custom game modes.
* Multiple Maps & Environments: Conquer 12 maps across 3 distinct landscapes.
* Rank Progression: Climb the ranks and prove your dominance in Ranked mode.
* Intuitive Mobile Controls: Enjoy smooth and responsive touch controls designed for mobile RTS.
* No Ads or In-App Purchases: Enjoy the full game experience uninterrupted.

Are you ready to conquer the future? Download MechCom - 3D RTS and unleash your strategic genius!
